categories.main_business_segments: Shanxi C&Y Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceuticals and health supplements. The company also provides medical health services including medical diagnostics, gene preservation, and prenatal environment testing. Its product portfolio includes anti-infective drugs, anti-allergy drugs, respiratory system drugs, urinary system drugs, kidney disease drugs, pediatric medicines, cardiovascular drugs, antidepressants, pharmaceutical raw materials and intermediates, as well as health foods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs GMP-compliant manufacturing processes ensuring high-quality pharmaceutical production. It uses advanced pharmaceutical research and development techniques, including bioequivalence studies and consistency evaluations for generic drugs. The company has a dedicated R&D team and innovation system focusing on high-end pharmaceuticals, precision medicine, and health supplements, with several patented technologies and proprietary formulations. Production is managed under a sales-driven 'produce-to-order' model with strict quality control from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, pharmacies, and retail drug stores primarily within China. Its customers include medical institutions and end consumers in the pharmaceutical and health supplement markets. The company also targets specialized markets such as gene preservation and prenatal testing services. The sales channels include distributors with medical sales qualifications and direct sales for raw materials and services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanxi C&Y Pharmaceutical Group operates mainly in China, with significant sales in the North China, East China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, South China, and Northeast regions. The company has subsidiaries and production bases in Zhejiang, Sichuan, Jiangsu, Tibet, and other provinces. Overseas sales are minimal and have declined significantly.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It is involved in pharmaceutical manufacturing, health supplement production, and medical service provision, including diagnostics and gene preservation. It procures raw materials and packaging, manufactures finished pharmaceutical products, and distributes them through a network of qualified distributors to hospitals and pharmacies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-end pharmaceutical development, precision medicine, and health supplements. It emphasizes accelerating R&D, especially in cardiovascular, chronic kidney, and urinary system diseases. The company pursues innovation through in-house R&D, patent development, and product consistency evaluations. It aims to enhance its product pipeline with new drug registrations and technical improvements, supported by a modular and standardized R&D process and expert teams.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of pharmaceutical products and health supplements. The company sells products to distributors who then supply hospitals and pharmacies. It also earns income from medical health services such as diagnostics and gene preservation. Sales are conducted via a combination of distributor-based distribution and direct sales, with additional revenue from commercial services and asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a mid-sized pharmaceutical group with a focus on high-end generics and precision medicine. It holds a competitive position through its diversified product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and compliance with national drug procurement and insurance policies. The company faces industry challenges such as drug price reductions due to centralized procurement and regulatory reforms but aims to maintain competitiveness via innovation and quality assurance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 799 million, a slight decrease of 3.58% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 25.2 million, marking a significant turnaround from a loss in the prior year. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.43 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 600 million. R&D investment accounted for 7.67% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation. The company experienced a decline in cash flow from operations but improved investment cash flow due to asset disposals.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, GMP-compliant pharmaceutical products with a focus on high-end generics and precision medicine. It differentiates through a broad product range covering multiple therapeutic areas, proprietary patents, and a strong R&D pipeline. Its integrated business model combines pharmaceutical manufacturing with health services like gene preservation, enhancing customer value. The company also leverages a stable sales network, academic promotion, and brand building to strengthen market presence and ensure product quality and supply reliability.
